definitions.explanation: A formal term for someone who writes professionally, encompassing novelists, essayists, and other literary figures.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{文筆家|ぶんぴつか}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: She is active as a writer.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{文筆家|ぶんぴつか}が{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: A young writer is attracting attention.

examples.japanese: {文筆家|ぶんぴつか}を{目指|めざ}して{毎日|まいにち}{書|か}き{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: I keep writing every day, aiming to become a professional writer.

notes:
A formal compound meaning someone who writes for a living. Combines {文筆|ぶんぴつ} (writing, literary work) and {家|か} (professional/expert). Covers a broad range of writing professions, not limited to fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文筆家|ぶんぴつか}として{生計|せいけい}を{立|た}てる: to make a living as a writer
- {文筆家|ぶんぴつか}を{志|こころざ}す: to aspire to be a writer
- {文筆|ぶんぴつ}{活動|かつどう}: literary activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作家|さっか}: author/novelist — the most common general term for writers, especially fiction
- {著者|ちょしゃ}: author — emphasizes being the author of a specific work
- {物書|ものか}き: writer — informal/humble term for someone who writes
